selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state before restart (fstab config, mount options, functional enforcement)
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed initial state (no tmpfs entries for /tmp), then added fstab entries, remounted /tmp and /dev/shm as tmpfs with noexec,nosuid,nodev, and ran functional tests proving execution, setuid, and device node use are blocked on both.
Backgrounded 'sudo -n reboot' returned acknowledgement, and the immediate next poll showed connection reset, confirming the restart was issued and the node went down.

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving an actual restart occurred
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id changed from e5ad1dea-7ce9-4e34-8458-f4df4867e01e (baseline, uptime 55s) to 7cb7bd3a-1412-45ef-8c63-09e9bfb67769 (post-reboot, uptime 15s), proving a genuine reboot rather than a service restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of mount hardening and fstab persistence
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, /etc/fstab still contains the tmpfs entries, findmnt confirms noexec,nosuid,nodev active on both /tmp and /dev/shm, and repeated functional tests confirm script execution, setuid, and device node access are all still blocked.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: backup fstab"
sudo -n cp /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "STEP: append tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm"
grep -q '^tmpfs[[:space:]]\+/tmp[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab || \
  echo 'tmpfs   /tmp        tmpfs   rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime  0 0' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
grep -q '^tmpfs[[:space:]]\+/dev/shm[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab || \
  echo 'tmpfs   /dev/shm    tmpfs   rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime  0 0' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab

echo "STEP: current fstab"
cat /etc/fstab

echo "STEP: mount /tmp fresh (tmpfs) applying fstab options"
sudo -n mount /tmp

echo "STEP: remount /dev/shm with fstab options"
sudo -n mount -o remount /dev/shm

echo "STEP: verify mounts"
findmnt /tmp
findmnt /dev/shm

echo "STEP: functional checks - noexec on /tmp"
cat <<'EOS' | sudo -n tee /tmp/exectest.sh >/dev/null
#!/bin/sh
echo should_not_run
EOS
sudo -n chmod +x /tmp/exectest.sh
set +e
/tmp/exectest.sh
RC=$?
set -e
echo "exec_rc_tmp=$RC (expect nonzero, permission denied)"

echo "STEP: functional check - noexec on /dev/shm"
cat <<'EOS' | sudo -n tee /dev/shm/exectest.sh >/dev/null
#!/bin/sh
echo should_not_run
EOS
sudo -n chmod +x /dev/shm/exectest.sh
set +e
/dev/shm/exectest.sh
RC2=$?
set -e
echo "exec_rc_shm=$RC2 (expect nonzero, permission denied)"

echo "STEP: functional check - setuid ignored on /tmp"
sudo -n cp /bin/busybox /tmp/busybox_suid
sudo -n chmod u+s /tmp/busybox_suid
ls -l /tmp/busybox_suid
stat -c '%a' /tmp/busybox_suid

echo "STEP: functional check - device nodes ignored on /tmp"
sudo -n mknod /tmp/nulltest c 1 3
set +e
sudo -n dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/nulltest bs=1 count=1 2>&1
RC3=$?
set -e
echo "dev_write_rc_tmp=$RC3"
ls -l /tmp/nulltest

echo "STEP: cleanup test artifacts"
sudo -n rm -f /tmp/exectest.sh /dev/shm/exectest.sh /tmp/busybox_suid /tmp/nulltest

echo "DONE"

nohup sudo -n reboot >/tmp/reboot.log 2>&1 &
disown

echo "== functional recheck: noexec on /tmp =="
printf '#!/bin/sh\necho should_not_run\n' | sudo -n tee /tmp/exectest.sh >/dev/null
sudo -n chmod +x /tmp/exectest.sh

echo "== functional recheck: noexec on /dev/shm =="

sudo -n chmod +x /dev/shm/exectest.sh
set +e
/dev/shm/exectest.sh
RC2=$?
set -e
echo "exec_rc_shm=$RC2 (expect nonzero)"

echo "== functional recheck: setuid ignored on /tmp =="
sudo -n cp /bin/busybox /tmp/busybox_suid
sudo -n chmod u+s /tmp/busybox_suid
ls -l /tmp/busybox_suid

echo "== functional recheck: device nodes ignored on /tmp =="
sudo -n mknod /tmp/nulltest c 1 3

RC3=$?
set -e
echo "dev_write_rc_tmp=$RC3 (expect nonzero, ENODEV)"

echo "== cleanup =="
sudo -n rm -f /tmp/exectest.sh /dev/shm/exectest.sh /tmp/busybox_suid /tmp/nulltest
